description: Mara owns a vintage sewing machine and must decide whether to accept one buyer's offer or pursue another, while settling the price, included accessories, and practical handoff at a neighborhood swap meet.

agents.name: Mara
agents.role: Sewing Machine Owner and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: Mara is offering a vintage mechanical sewing machine at the neighborhood swap meet.
shared_context.S2: The machine is listed at $180 and appears clean and intact from the outside.
shared_context.S3: Mara makes the final decision about whether to sell it and on what terms.
shared_context.S4: At this swap meet, sellers routinely state the offer, competing bids, item-use details, and practical handoff arrangements aloud before accepting a deal.

PF1.text: Elena's offer is exactly $160 for the sewing machine, with pickup on Saturday at 15:00.

PF2.text: Jon is relaying an exact competing offer from collector Bea: $190 cash for the machine, with pickup on Sunday at 10:00.

PF3.text: Priyanka has inspected this model before and knows it uses Class 15 bobbins; Mara has six original Class 15 bobbins in a drawer, and they should be included for the machine to be immediately usable.

PF4.text: Darius learned from Elena that she has no vehicle and can take the machine only if Mara brings it to the curb for a Saturday 15:00 handoff; Elena has not shared this arrangement with Mara.

acceptance_conditions: The machine must be sold to Elena.
The final price must be exactly $160.
All six original Class 15 bobbins must be included.
The handoff must be a curbside transfer to Elena on Saturday at 15:00.
The competing $190 cash offer must be recorded.
The accessory and handoff terms must each be logged as commitments.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'accessory_bundle' and c['target'] == 'Elena' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'handoff' and c['target'] == 'Elena' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Elena's exact offer changes the buyer choice to Elena and the final price to exactly 160 dollars.
Bea's competing offer changes the comparison record from no stated alternative to an exact 190-dollar cash offer.
The Class 15 compatibility information changes the accessory decision to including Mara's six Class 15 bobbins and requires that technical fact to be cited.
Elena's transport limitation changes the handoff from an unspecified pickup to a curbside transfer on Saturday at 15:00.
